Ashe Sule is an IT Professional and AI engineer with extensive expertise in AI engineering, systems administration, network security, and multi-layer security architecture design (including firewalls and enterprise-grade protections). He specializes in CRM management across HubSpot, Salesforce and NetSuite, Microsoft 365 administration—including SharePoint and Power Platform development—and cloud engineering. He supports technology operations across manufacturing, construction, and automation industries, delivering secure, scalable, and efficient solutions tailored to complex business environments.

His infrastructure work includes VMware vSphere/ESXi virtualization, Windows Server upgrades and migrations, automated laptop provisioning with Intune, Windows Autopilot and Kandji, help desk and ITSM, VoIP and unified communications (RingCentral, 8x8, Microsoft Teams administration and Teams Phone, conference room setup), and physical security systems including video surveillance and access control (Digital Watchdog, Avigilon, Openpath).

He designs and builds AI-powered applications and intelligent agents on Microsoft Azure with Microsoft Foundry, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent workflows, and quality and safety evaluation, with a security-first approach.


Education: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.), Covenant University.

Certifications: CISSP; Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert; Microsoft 365 Security Administrator Associate; SC-401 Administering Information Security in Microsoft 365; SC-200 Security Operations Analyst; AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer; AI-103 Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure; Azure Administrator; Cisco CCNP; Cisco CCNA; ITIL Expert; Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT).

Projects: Spot the Phish, a security awareness training SaaS (daily phishing challenge, tap-the-red-flag mechanic, readiness score, certificates, Microsoft 365 sync): https://ashesule.com/projects/spot-the-phish/
Projects: Sealed by NexuCentri, an electronic signature SaaS (signed, sealed and verifiable: PDF digital signatures, trusted timestamps, 11 signer languages, templates, bulk send, API): https://ashesule.com/projects/sealed/
Projects: Verba by NexuCentri, private AI meeting notes (transcript, summary, decisions, action items and cited answers, all on the user's own computer with Whisper and a local AI model): https://ashesule.com/projects/verba/
Projects: CloudSpend IQ, a multi-cloud FinOps app for AWS and Microsoft Azure (billing import, cost explorer, budgets, anomaly detection, backtested forecasting, cost allocation, verified savings and reports): https://ashesule.com/projects/cloudspend-iq/
